title: Total time expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly derived and expressed as t = 3√(mL/(eE)).

title: Tangent of angle
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must correctly state tanθ = 3.

title: Impact distance
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (3) must correctly state the distance from O as y = 4.5L.

title: Acceleration analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law to find accelerations a1 = eE/m and a2 = 3eE/m.

title: Kinematics in region E1
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use kinematics to find the time t1 and velocity v at line MN from the motion under a1.

title: Velocity components at exit
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the vertical velocity component gained in region E2 and relate it to tanθ.

title: Total displacement calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly combine the vertical displacement in E2 with the drift after E2 to find the total y.

title: Time segmentation
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may clearly break the total time into segments t1 (in E1), t2 (field-free to screen), and t3 (in E2).

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns the direction of acceleration or velocity for the electron (negative charge).

title: Kinematics misapplication
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly applies constant-acceleration or constant-velocity formulas to the wrong motion segments.
